bootstrap.unit: respondent; ordinary iid row bootstrap, n draws with replacement
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5; finite replicates only, valid counts retained
bootstrap.scope: fixed models and current empirical sample only; not training/selection uncertainty or complex survey inference

calibration.method: equal width [0,0.1,...,1], left closed except final bin includes 1
calibration.interval: Wilson 95% interval for observed fraction in each occupied bin; descriptive, no multiplicity adjustment
calibration.empty_bins: retain table row; do not draw point

permutation.unit: original input column through full frozen Pipeline
permutation.variation: SD across permutations, not a confidence interval

subgroups.interval: Wilson 95% recall/FPR intervals; descriptive, not adjusted for multiple comparisons
subgroups.missing: report Unknown separately if present; do not drop rows

weights: main unweighted; finalwt-weighted point sensitivity separately; no complex-design CI
validation_test_comparison: descriptive deltas only; validation used for selection, no significance claim from its gap
stability: reuse stage4 stability.csv; conditional fixed-parameter development CV, no extra fitting
